items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury. Rapoport/Barshop corroborate he will be listed as limited.
items.why: Left practice early; listed limited on report.
items.implication: Monitor Friday report; high target share already elevated post-Adams.
items.opportunity: Target monopoly if limited/out; heavy personnel possible.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Elevated risk of OUT or limited role Week 7 vs SEA.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy/others target upside if out.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin suffered torn patellar tendon, out for season (confirmed Tuesday by Quinn/Rapoport). Berry breaks down Commanders offense impact; Diggs and others elevate.
items.why: Torn left patellar tendon; surgery needed.
items.implication: Season over; WAS WR depth chart shifts permanently ROS.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice per Jets Thursday injury report.
items.implication: Path to active vs MIA; monitor full status.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries if cleared in slow-paced game.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical/non-football activities at facility. MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush (OL mess too). Discussed long-term outlook on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Non-football activities permitted; backups poor EPA.
items.implication: Positive ROS signal for Jacobs workload return; handcuffs weak.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps once cleared; avoid relying on Lloyd/Johnson.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley is expected to return to practice today and is in line to play Monday against the Cowboys. Berry notes efficient in full games played and Dallas is strong RB matchup; ranks around RB15.
items.why: Sources say return to practice and in line for MNF.
items.implication: RB1/2 restart; volume with Hurts mending and banged-up backfield.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone lead; Dallas allows strong RB fantasy.

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace: TB @ CAR up in pace (Bucs PROE climb, Panthers explosive/high snaps). MIA @ NYJ slow-paced slogs (lowest combined snaps). GB/DET and LAR/LV also high volume.
items.implication: More opportunities in TB/CAR; avoid volume in MIA/NYJ.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/play volume for skill players in up-tempo games.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (eligible IR return next week) not expected ready; recovery 'will take some time.' Biggest Adams beneficiary delayed. Rams only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.implication: Nuclear target share for Puka ROS/Week 7+.
items.opportunity: 25 targets/game projection; heavy TE sets otherwise.
items.conflict: New calf issue adds short-term risk.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS uncertainty; possible landing spot upgrade/downgrade.

items.text: Berry LOVES A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Bears good for yardage; Brown back in real role.
Berry LOVES DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11). Elite volume.
items.opportunity: Target share with Saquon return still strong.

items.text: Berry LOVES Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12). Lions pass-catcher buffet; big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Workloads + defenses carved up by RBs/pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Carries/targets/red-zone in up-tempo or soft spots.

items.text: Berry HATES Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA, Josh Jacobs @ DET, Cam Skattebo @ HOU. Nasty matchups, role/target issues, layoff workload questions.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive long-term on Jacobs.

items.text: Giants plan to start JJ McCarthy vs Houston. Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: McCarthy 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9). Different scheme/coaches/small sample but concerning.
items.implication: Efficiency concern for Jefferson until McCarthy improves.
items.opportunity: Still volume but lower YAC/efficiency risk.
